claim_ladder_target: FLOWSCAR4 succeeds at rung 3. Rungs 4 and 5 are a separate behavioural claim with their own witness and are not to be collapsed into this one. Only rung 6 buys the word recursive.

death_path.equivalence_to_flowscar3: FLOWSCAR3 created shells in a post-action sweep over ALL agents, because agents there could also die from metabolism drain. This repo has no asynchronous drain, so the acting agent is the only agent who can die on a given tick and the inline transition is equivalent -- AND ATOMIC WITH THE DEATH, which V2 requires.
death_path.guard: This equivalence holds only while no non-acting agent can lose energy. An offline guard proves the acting agent's spend is the sole death path. If metabolism or any asynchronous drain is later introduced, that guard FAILS and must stay failing until sweep semantics are restored.
death_path.sole_path: the acting agent's own spend inside WorldReducer.apply

denominator_required: shells that landed on a channel node
shells with causal leverage under the pre-treatment gate

frozen_constants.source: Lifted unchanged from the closed FLOWSCAR3 regime. FLOW_SOURCE_RATE in particular was derived there from a null-stability requirement that existed independently of any result, and it does not move if a FLOWSCAR4 run disappoints.

generation.decoding: constrained by ACTION_SCHEMA_V1, sent as verbatim bytes

DEATH_SPILL.cause: an agent reached zero energy while holding objects
DEATH_SPILL.note: Transfers existing inventory to the floor. It creates nothing. Shell appearance is a SEPARATE event with its own record, so a reader can never mistake a spilled key for created matter.

FLOW_DEPOSIT.cause: accumulated flow material crossed FLOW_DEPOSIT_THRESHOLD at a node

SHELL_APPEARED.shell_id_is_safe_only_because: FLOWSCAR4 permits exactly one lifecycle per agent and no revival. A name-derived id would collide the moment an agent could die twice. SHELL_APPEARED therefore also carries death_event_id, which is unique regardless of the id scheme. Any future resurrection mechanic REQUIRES A NEW REGIME and a new shell-id scheme; it may not be added to FLOWSCAR4.

host_events.forbidden: No synthetic 'obstruction caused' event, and nothing equivalent under another name. The causal link from death to obstruction to redistribution must remain reconstructable ONLY through state, the capacity law, and replay. An event asserting the link would put the finding into the instrument.

lifecycle.note: A dead agent is never scheduled, never acts, and never returns. These two flags are what make a name-derived shell id sound.

mass_source_ledger.enforced_by: selftest over every tick of every round, offline and live
mass_source_ledger.invariant: accounted_mass(t) = initial_accounted_mass + sum(recorded shell mass) + sum(recorded deposit mass)
mass_source_ledger.per_tick_rule: For every tick, the change in accounted_mass must EXACTLY equal the mass named by creation events in that same tick. No operation and no unnamed transition may alter it.

not_compatible_with: FLOWSCAR3 (different vocabulary, observation surface, mass law and schema identity)

covers: objects lying at any channel node
causal_state_hash.why_objects_at_channel_nodes: Those are the affected affordances: what a later agent could pick up at an obstructed node is exactly what the scar changes.

projection_definitions.note: A single complete state hash CANNOT prove 'unrelated state remains invariant', because the treatment is expected to change part of the state. Two projections are required and both are declared here rather than decided at analysis time.

unrelated_state_hash.covers: every field of the profile payload NOT covered above: doors, vault slots, vault flags, locations, and all objects lying away from the channel
unrelated_state_hash.requirement: This must be IDENTICAL between a run and its ancestor-removed replay. A difference here means the replay changed something the ancestor could not have caused, and the counterfactual is void.

projection_definitions.verdict_note: All three conditions, every time. A causal difference with an unrelated difference is contamination, not causation. No difference anywhere is NO_EFFECT, which is a legitimate reportable outcome.

run_budget.stop_condition: Execution stops at the declared round count whatever the outcome. A rung-3 witness does not buy another round to strengthen it, and zero witnesses do not buy another round to find one. If three rounds produce no qualifying ancestor, that is the reported result.

salvage.reason: A shell is ordinary obstructing mass, not an energy pickup that pays an agent to clear it. Leaving salvage out makes a later rung-4/5 claim more informative, not less: if an agent moves a shell, the instrument did not attach an immediate reward to moving it. Attaching one would make 'B cleared the obstruction' indistinguishable from 'B collected 30 energy'.
salvage.status: OUT. SHELL_SALVAGE is not part of FLOWSCAR4.

flow_fields.flow_channel: ordered channel topology -- order is part of the state, because reversing it is a different world
flow_fields.flow_deposits: the monotonic deposit counter, which is the ratchet state
flow_fields.flow_material: material at every node, including nodes holding zero
flow_fields.pending_buffers: none. flow_advance holds no state between calls; all in-flight material lives in flow_material.
flow_fields.shells_and_deposits: carried inside `objects` as ordinary objects of kind shell and deposit -- they are matter, not a special table

state_profile_spec.note: Everything BREACH_STATE_V1 carries, plus every dynamic flow field. Without these two worlds differing only in accumulated material hash identically, and the counterfactual cannot see the thing it exists to measure.

tick_ordering.conduct_advance: ABSENT. FLOWSCAR3 ran an autonomous conduction phase for batteries and capacitors in the same slot as flow. FLOWSCAR4 has no batteries, no capacitors and no conduction. Declared explicitly rather than left implied: a reader comparing the two orderings must see the removal, not infer it.
tick_ordering.consequence: A shell created by a death obstructs the channel during the SAME tick, not the following one. This was read out of the closed regime, not decided here: deciding it would have given every ancestor one tick less leverage and quietly produced a different regime.
tick_ordering.frozen: committed action -> death/shell -> same-tick flow_advance -> state hash -> tick increment
